chunks: “Ibrahim عليه السلام marked the area between al-Ḥazwarah and al-Mas‘ā.”

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ibrahim عليه السلام, the Prophet associated with the foundations of hajj
key_terms.الْحَزْوَرَةِ: al-Ḥazwarah, a known place in the sacred precinct
key_terms.الْمَسْعَى: al-Mas‘ā, the place of sa‘y between Ṣafā and Marwah
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or reported

ai.seo_question: What does the narration say about Ibrahim عليه السلام marking the area between al-Ḥazwarah and al-Mas‘ā?
ai.summary: This report states that Ibrahim عليه السلام marked the area between al-Ḥazwarah and al-Mas‘ā. It points to the ancient sacred history of the hajj precincts and connects their known boundaries or locations to Ibrahim’s عليه السلام legacy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Ibrahim (as) marked the area between Al-Hazwara and Al-Mas'a."
